Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.desktop.ui

Class ShopPageState

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.desktop.ui.ShopPageState
public final class ShopPageState extends Object
Pure-Java model of the shop page (GDD 1.4): whether it is open, and the shopkeeper it trades with. The game is paused while it is open. Leaving the page keeps the shop open: the next round starts only when the player asks for it (GDD 1.2).
